## [IT Site Lead (Alpharetta, GA)](https://builtin.com/job/it-site-lead-alpharetta-ga/12037328)

7 Days AgoSaved


In-Office

Alpharetta, GA, USA

Cloud • Software

Provides hands-on IT leadership for the Alpharetta office, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux devices, networks, servers, Google Workspace, SaaS access, endpoint security, and service desk operations. Manages onboarding, offboarding, hardware inventory, licensing, documentation, compliance, incident response, and local IT policies. Troubleshoots technical issues, supports HIPAA and PHI requirements, coordinates hardware and software rollouts, and ensures changes follow established ITSM and change-management practices.

## [Product Specialist](https://builtin.com/job/product-specialist/11217668)

One Month AgoSaved


In-Office or Remote

Alpharetta, GA, USA

Cloud • Software

Serve as an expert on Curve Dental software, delivering product demonstrations, analyzing customer and market feedback, identifying product opportunities, and representing user needs to Development. Create educational materials, collaborate on enhancements, position the product against competitors, and support cross-functional teams. The role requires strong presentations, analytical problem-solving, healthcare operations knowledge, and dental software experience. Travel may occur up to twice monthly.
